headline: Fisherman's Row Flares as Shelf Fight Endures
war_summary: Since the midday edition Fisherman's Row has seized the lead with 14 changes in two hours and 45 on the day to 18:10 centred on Eidolo, Black Well and Dankana Post, holdings now standing at five Warden, three Colonial and one neutral with both casualty rates accelerating in the last hour. Stlican Shelf remains hot with nine changes in two hours and 38 on the day to 17:55 about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, holdings three Warden and six Colonial with day losses of 2,117 Colonial and 2,414 Warden and rates still accelerating. Weathered Expanse has quickened again to five changes in two hours though still 62 on the day about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, holdings four Warden and five Colonial with heavy day losses of 8,901 Colonial and 14,800 Warden. Marban Hollow has flared with four changes in two hours, all six on the day about Mox, holdings eight Colonial. Mooring County shows two changes in two hours and Nevish Line one, the latter cooling from earlier pace with holdings seven Warden and one Colonial, while Callahan's Passage, Palantine Berm and Godcrofts record no change in the last two hours.
